notes: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan/HK): Mainland-term and simplified-character leak rules. HK variant (--variant hk) relaxes 激光/軟件/質素/網絡. See references/zh-Hant.md §1-2.

rules.pattern: [设认标优软网络应该这个对会说时间国与来们没发过学体经动长现实样还进电机气门问题买卖车欢为从后当档]|[這这那哪心手家夜眼嘴屋腦脑夢梦懷怀]里|里(?:面|頭|头|邊|边)(?=[的有是，。、！？!?,.\s]|$)
rules.message: Simplified-only character in a zh-Hant string (mechanical OpenCC or wrong table?). 里 counts only in its inside sense (這里, 心里, 里面), which zh-Hant writes 裡 or 裏
rules.note: Narrowed after the 2026-11-27 run, where the bare character 里 fired on 17 lines with transliterated character names (such as 哈里森). 里 is a valid Traditional character for names, units such as 公里 and the Taiwanese ward (里長), so it left the character class. Only the inside sense is caught, after 這 这 那 哪 and nouns such as 心 手 家 夜 眼, or as 里面 里頭 里邊 at the end of a phrase.

rules.pattern: (?:設置|全屏|默認|鼠標|分辨率|空格鍵|軟件|視頻|網絡|服務器|菜單|存盤|等離子)|(?:重新|自動|請先|無法|尚未)登錄(?!在案|為|於)|登錄(?:帳號|帳戶|賬號|账号|遊戲|游戏|伺服器|服務器|服务器|密碼|密码|畫面|界面|介面|頁面|页面|失敗|失败|成功|狀態|逾時|超時)|^\s*登錄\s*$|請登錄(?=[。！？!?，,\s]|$)
rules.message: Mainland term in zh-Hant. Use 設定 / 全螢幕 / 預設 / 滑鼠 / 解析度 / 空白鍵, and 登入 to log in. 登錄 in the sense of on record (登錄在案) is Taiwanese and passes
rules.note: Narrowed after the 2026-11-27 run, where 登錄在案 (on record, registered) fired. 登錄 now fires only in its login sense, next to an account, game, server, password, screen, failure or success word, after 重新 自動 請先 無法 尚未, as 請登錄 at the end of a clause, or alone as a button label.

nomatch: 您的掃描報告也已經登錄在案
資料已登錄為正式紀錄

rules.message: Mainland character '硅' in zh-Hant: Taiwan/HK standard for Silicon is '矽'
Mainland '優化': Taiwan settings UI uses '最佳化' (tolerated in patch notes/dialogue)
Mainland '土辦法': use '應急土法 / 拼湊頂著用'
Translationese passive '被…所…': use natural active Chinese

rules.pattern: 已存在一個|已經存在一個
rules.message: Robotic '此處已存在一個物品': use '這個位置已經有東西了'

nomatch: 這個位置已經有東西了！

rules.message: '應用' as the Apply-settings button: Taiwan uses '套用'
Literal '體力過低': use '體力不夠了 / 沒力氣了'

rules.pattern: (?:屏幕|激光|信息|質素|數據|打印|的士)
rules.message: HK vocabulary: legitimate only in a zh-HK build (pass --variant hk to downgrade to WARN)
Mainland '程序' for program: Taiwan uses '程式' (程序 = procedure is fine)
Mainland '質量' for quality: Taiwan prefers '品質' (fine for physics mass)
Mainland '文件' for digital file: Taiwan uses '檔案'
Mainland quotes: use 「」
Gendered 'you' 妳: use 你
'when…' frame: use '……時'

rules.pattern: 進行(?:修理|製造|製作|建造|升級|購買|儲存|載入)
rules.message: '進行' + verbal noun: use the plain verb
'successfully' calque '成功地'
Full-width digit/Latin: use half-width
Wrong ellipsis: use '……'

rules.pattern: (?:小子|小夥子|丫頭|小姑娘|哥們|兄弟|姊妹|帥哥|美女)
rules.message: Gendered address to the player (rows tagged player)
Written Cantonese in a non-HK build (pass --variant hk for Hong Kong dialogue)
